item.title: [6.8] India 10-year bond yield reverses half of last week's drop on elevated inflation
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

Indian government bonds experienced significant selling pressure ahead of a major auction for the benchmark paper. The yield on the 6.94% 2036 bond rose notably due to rising inflation in both India and the United States. The Reserve Bank of India is expected to raise interest rates again in early December due to persistent inflationary pressures.

WHY IT MATTERS

Directly impacts monetary policy expectations, interest rate trajectories, and global asset pricing.

item.title: [6.8] Envisioning Agentic Robotics: A New Era of Robotic Systems
item.description:
WHAT HAPPENED

The release of GPT-6 Astra marks the emergence of a new paradigm in robotics: agentic robotics. Within weeks, frontier models with agentic harnesses matched or exceeded task-specific policies on many embodied benchmarks. Instead of training a dedicated policy for each family of tasks, an agentic robotic system applies a foundation model to open-world embodied tasks.

WHY IT MATTERS

It synthesizes a major shift toward foundation-model-driven agentic robotics, though it serves more as a framing perspective than a hard technical breakthrough.
